address: 1-2 Hukou Street, Zhongzheng District, Taipei, 100, Taiwan
bio: Vintage furniture, terracotta tile flooring and exposed wooden beams make for a cosy European cottage feel. The chef, who previously worked in the US and Australia, delivers an interactive experience underpinned by classic European techniques and with Taiwanese accents – think pickled pineapple, salted egg and mian cha sweet soup. With their storytelling skills, the servers are engaging. Both the wine and zero-proof pairings are good options.
